component.name: IntactPDF
component.summary: Edit PDFs without rebuilding the document
Edita PDFs sin reconstruir el documento

description.p: IntactPDF edits the text, images and vector graphics of an existing PDF and saves it by appending to the file, the way the PDF specification intends. The output starts with the bytes of the original, so whatever was not edited cannot have changed.

Measured on a corpus of 12 deliberately awkward PDFs: 19 edits (deleting a vector, moving and resizing a CMYK image, rewriting a line of text) with zero pixels altered outside the edited region. Passing the same files through office suites and other editors rewrites the CMYK colours, drops the alpha masks, converts embedded images to JPEG and loses form fields and page rotation.

The window shows the page, its objects in a side panel and a ribbon with every option grouped by what it is for: it is always clear what is being edited, what is switched off because it does not apply, and what will happen when saving.

IntactPDF edita el texto, las imágenes y los vectores de un PDF que ya existe y guarda añadiendo al final del fichero, como manda la especificación. La salida empieza por los bytes del original, así que lo que no se ha editado es imposible que haya cambiado.

La ventana enseña la página, sus objetos en un panel lateral y una cinta con todas las opciones agrupadas por para qué sirven: en todo momento se ve qué se está editando, qué está apagado porque no aplica y qué va a pasar al guardar.
First release. Graphic interface with a ribbon of options, and the same editor available from the command line for scripts.
